title: 第1018章 大战起第1017章 最后的考验
content_zh:
听到金霄这番话，叶霄炎心中顿时了然，难怪这秘境之灵会叫金霄。
不过，这世上终究不是每个人都像叶霄炎这般，看待问题的角度，总是如此清奇。
蛮九荒站在一旁，神色凝重，沉声开口道：“敢问金霄大人，是何人通过了考验？”
此话一出，众人心神一凛，纷纷将目光投向金霄。
金霄并未立刻开口，只是缓缓抬眸，目光落在了叶霄炎的身上。
随着他的目光移动，四周众人的视线，也齐刷刷地落到了叶霄炎身上。
一时间，场中气氛微妙至极。
蛮九荒、祝九炎等人脸色顿时变得有些难看。
他们在幻境之中，都曾得到过天火圣人传承的些许东西，也都曾亲身接触过那股力量，深知那代表着何等可怕的存在。
那不是普通的机缘，更不是随便什么人都能触碰的造化，而是一道足以让人脱胎换骨、一步登天的无上传承。
可如今，这样的传承，竟然要他们就这么直接放弃？
他们怎么可能甘心！
更何况，叶霄炎本就强大得离谱，若是再让他得到天火圣人的传承，那他们还哪里会有半点活路？
到那时，别说争夺机缘，恐怕连自身的立足之地都不会再有。
而另一边，秦烈望着叶霄炎，眼中却闪过一抹了然之色。
是叶霄炎的话，那倒也合理。
毕竟，只有像叶霄炎这样强得近乎离谱的存在，才有可能真正通过这幻境考验。
若换成旁人，恐怕连幻境深处都未必能踏入，更别说得到秘境之灵的认可了。
与此同时，炎赤血等人原本脸上还残留着几分不甘与阴沉。
炎族的未来，似乎依旧笼罩在一层浓重的阴影之下，看不清前路，也看不到希望。

然而，当他们的目光顺着金霄所指，落到叶霄炎身上的那一瞬间，炎赤血的脸色却是猛地一变，眼中更是瞬间迸发出凶厉之色。
他死死盯着叶霄炎身旁的两道身影，厉声喝道：“天虎！地虎！你们在做什么？你们为什么会待在人族蝼蚁的身边！”
听到炎赤血的话，炎天虎的神色微微一变。
不过，与炎龙不同，炎天虎虽然现在也效忠叶霄炎，却并没有得到叶霄炎的本命精血，所以他并不像炎龙那般，对叶霄炎有着近乎绝对的死忠。
可即便如此，此刻的炎天虎，眼神中依旧没有太多迟疑。
他望向炎赤血，缓缓开口道：“赤血哥，我们才是正义的一方，一直以来，你们，还有族群的路，都走错了！”
此言一出，炎赤血先是一怔，随即怒极反笑。
“好，好一个我们的路都走错了！”
他面目阴沉，眼底杀意翻涌，声音更是冷得像冰，
“背叛族群，投靠该死的人族，今天我炎赤血，就要替我炎族，清理门户！”
话音落下，炎赤血仰天长啸一声，身形骤然暴起，整个人化作一道猩红血线，带着惊人的杀机，直冲炎天虎而去！
那速度快若闪电，所过之处，连空气都被撕裂出尖锐的爆鸣声。
眼见炎赤血直接杀来，炎天虎却并没有在第一时间出手。
他只是站在原地，目光却不由自主地看向了叶霄炎，眼神之中，竟流露出几分近乎恳求的意味。
显然，他是希望叶霄炎能够展露出炎帝姿态。
content_en:
Hearing Jin Xiao's words, Ye Xiaoyan suddenly understood. No wonder the spirit of the secret realm was called Jin Xiao.
However, after all, not everyone in this world is like Ye Xiaoyan, who always looks at problems from such a unique perspective.
Man Jiuhuang stood aside, with a solemn look on his face, and said in a deep voice: "May I ask Lord Jin Xiao, who has passed the test?"
As soon as these words came out, everyone's hearts trembled, and they all turned their attention to Jin Xiao.
Jin Xiao did not speak immediately, but slowly raised his eyes and landed on Ye Xiaoyan.
As his eyes moved, the eyes of everyone around him also fell on Ye Xiaoyan.
For a moment, the atmosphere in the venue was extremely delicate.
The faces of Man Jiuhuang, Zhu Jiuyan and others suddenly became a little ugly.
In the illusion, they had all received some things passed down by the Heavenly Fire Saint, and they had all had personal contact with that power, and knew full well what a terrifying existence it represented.
That is not an ordinary chance, nor is it a creation that can be touched by just anyone, but a supreme inheritance that can make a person completely reborn and reach the sky in one step.
But now, such a heritage requires them to give up just like that?
How could they be willing to do so!
What's more, Ye Xiaoyan is already ridiculously powerful. If he is allowed to obtain the inheritance of the Heavenly Fire Saint, how will they have any chance of survival?
By then, let alone fighting for opportunities, I am afraid that I will no longer even have a foothold.
On the other side, Qin Lie looked at Ye Xiaoyan, with a hint of understanding flashing in his eyes.
If it was Ye Xiaoyan, that would be reasonable.
After all, only an almost ridiculously strong being like Ye Xiaoyan could truly pass this illusion test.
If it were anyone else, he might not even be able to step into the depths of the illusion, let alone get the approval of the spirit of the secret realm.
At the same time, Yan Chixue and others still had a bit of unwillingness and gloominess on their faces.
The future of the Yan Clan still seems to be shrouded in a heavy shadow, with no way forward and no hope.
However, the moment their eyes followed what Jin Xiao was pointing and landed on Ye Xiaoyan, Yan Chixue's expression suddenly changed, and a fierce look burst out in his eyes.
He stared at the two figures beside Ye Xiaoyan and shouted sternly: "Sky Tiger! Earth Tiger! What are you doing? Why are you staying next to the human ants!"
Hearing Yan Chixue's words, Yan Tianhu's expression changed slightly.
However, unlike Yan Long, although Yan Tianhu is now loyal to Ye Xiaoyan, he has not received Ye Xiaoyan's life essence and blood, so he does not have an almost absolute loyalty to Ye Xiaoyan like Yan Long.
But even so, Yan Tianhu still didn't have much hesitation in his eyes at this moment.
He looked at Yan Chixue and slowly said: "Brother Chixue, we are the righteous party. All along, you and the clan have been on the wrong path!"
As soon as these words came out, Yan Chixue was startled for a moment, and then he laughed angrily.
"Okay, okay, we've gone the wrong way!"
His face was gloomy, murderous intent surged in his eyes, and his voice was as cold as ice.
"Betray the clan and join the damn human race. Today, I, Yan Chixue, will clean up the family for my Yan clan!"
After the words fell, Yan Chixue raised his head to the sky and let out a long roar. His figure suddenly rose up, and his whole body turned into a line of scarlet blood. With an astonishing murderous intention, he rushed straight towards Yan Tianhu!
The speed was as fast as lightning, and wherever it passed, even the air was torn apart with a sharp explosion.
Seeing Yan Chixue coming to kill directly, Yan Tianhu did not take action immediately.
He just stood there, but his eyes couldn't help but look at Ye Xiaoyan, and there was something almost pleading in his eyes.
Obviously, he hoped that Ye Xiaoyan could show his attitude as Emperor Yan.
